description: This file defines the class ThreadCheckingRepaintManager, which extends RepaintManager to add thread-checking functionality within a Swing application, ensuring that Swing components are modified only from the Event Dispatch Thread and providing debugging output when violations occur.

classes.name: ThreadCheckingRepaintManager
classes.description: A custom RepaintManager that checks if Swing component modifications are made from the Event Dispatch Thread and outputs diagnostic information when violations occur. It can also dump the component hierarchy for debugging purposes.

methods.name: ThreadCheckingRepaintManager
methods.description: Constructor for initializing the repaint manager, optionally enabling checking for whether components are showing.

methods.name: addInvalidComponent
methods.description: Overrides the method to check thread violations before adding an invalid component for repaint.

methods.name: checkThread
methods.description: Checks if the current thread is the Event Dispatch Thread; if not and the component is showing (or checkIsShowing is false), prints debug info.

methods.name: getStracktraceAsString
methods.description: Converts an exception's stack trace into a string for debugging.

methods.name: checkIsShowing
methods.description: Determines whether to check if a component is showing based on internal flag.

methods.name: addDirtyRegion
methods.description: Overrides to check thread violations when marking a region dirty for repaint.

methods.name: dumpComponentTree
methods.description: Prints the hierarchy of components starting from the given component, with indentation.

methods.name: resetTabCount
methods.description: Resets the indentation level for component tree printout.

methods.name: printTabIndent
methods.description: Prints tabs corresponding to current indentation level for tree hierarchy.
